text: U.K. GDP declined 0.1% in April. Services output contracted while construction output increased modestly and production output was unchanged. Businesses reported higher energy and fuel costs during the period. Inflationary pressure from energy markets remained present while economic growth weakened.

meta.note: Growth and inflation-related pressures moved in opposite directions within the same reporting period.

text: Iranian state media reported provisions of a proposed U.S.-Iran agreement involving sanctions relief, reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, withdrawal conditions, and reconstruction commitments. Public discussion of a potential signing timeline emerged while official approval and execution remained incomplete. The reported framework linked military, economic, and diplomatic structures through a single negotiating document.

meta.note: Reported terms entered public view, but final acceptance and implementation status remained unresolved.
